raw_segments.text: Mr. Bloom's glance traveled down the edge of the paper, scanning the deaths.
Callan, Coleman, Dignom, Fawcett, Lowery, Nom and Peake, what peak is that?
Is it the chap was in Crosby and Allen's?
Inked characters fast fading on the frayed breaking paper.
Thanks to the little flower, sadly missed, to the inexpressible grief of his.
Aged 88 after a long and tedious illness.
Month's mind, Quinlan, on whose soul's sweet Jesus have mercy.
